Package org.jlab.coda.emu.support.codaComponent

Interface CODAStateMachine

All Known Subinterfaces:
DataChannel, DataTransport, EmuModule
All Known Implementing Classes:
CODAStateMachineAdapter, DataChannelAdapter, DataChannelImplCmsg, DataChannelImplEmu, DataChannelImplEt, DataChannelImplFifo, DataChannelImplFile, DataChannelImplTcpStream, DataChannelImplUdpStream, DataTransportAdapter, DataTransportImplCmsg, DataTransportImplEmu, DataTransportImplEt, DataTransportImplFifo, DataTransportImplFile, DataTransportImplTcpStream, DataTransportImplUdpStream, Dummy, EventRecording, FarmController, FastEventBuilder, ModuleAdapter, RocFixedRateSimulation, RocSimulation, StreamAggregator, StreamAggregatorOrig, TsFixedRateSimulation, TsSimulation
public interface CODAStateMachine
This interface is used when defining data transports, data channels, and modules. It encompasses all state machine functions and the ability to notify others of an END event's arrival.
